Yeni Mobilya Taşımacılığı İşlem Rehberi

Yeni mobilya taşımacılığı için end-to-end çözümler. Fabrikadan teslim alma, paketleme, gümrük ve kurulum hizmetleriyle projenizi baştan sona yönetiyoruz.

text.en:
How Is New Furniture Shipping Done?

Han Bros Cargo's new furniture guide explains how we collect from factories, manage packing, customs and installation services to run the project end to end. We professionally manage all stages of new furniture shipping.

Service and Process Overview

  • Factory pickup: We collect your furniture from the manufacturer
  • Professional packing: Protection with special packaging
  • Customs procedures: We handle all customs documents
  • Secure transport: Shipping with special containers
  • Installation service: Assembly service at destination

Further Information

End-to-end solutions for new furniture shipping. We manage your project from start to finish with factory pickup, packing, customs and installation services.

Why Han Bros Cargo?

  • Professional team and experienced international logistics staff
  • Insured transport and transparent pricing
  • Expert support for post-Brexit customs procedures
  • 24/7 tracking and customer focused consultancy
  • On-time delivery and door to door service

Frequently Asked Questions

How can I get information about How Is New Furniture Shipping Done??

Fill in the quote form on our website or call customer services for free consultancy. Our expert team will propose a tailored solution.

How are timing and cost determined?

Pricing is based on volume, weight, origin and delivery address. A written quote is provided after survey with no hidden costs.

Do you support customs and insurance?

Yes. Han Bros Cargo manages post-Brexit customs and insurance options, with guidance on ToR and C3 procedures.
